name: Gentian Observation Diary
source:
A story about 2 girls (Nozomi Natsume, Kochi Fuyukawa) who become friends after Nozomi finds her during a beat down from a group of bullies. From then on, the two become friends. And from then on, Nozomi is stricken with an obsession blurring the lines of love and hatred.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260415143533/https://shinitai-tan.itch.io/gentian-observation-diary]itch.io[/url]]
